crossRefs.note: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with…
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: Consider your ways.
But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying…
The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

“Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.
